newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish automotive exports up 14 pct in Jan-Nov.
newsitem.headline: Turkish automotive exports up 14 pct in Jan-Nov.

text.p: Exports in the Turkish automotive sector rose by 14 percent to $1.205 billion in January-November, up from $1.057 billion in the same 1995 period, the automotive exporters' union said on Thursday.
Motor vehicle exports rose 18.9 percent to $474.76 million in the first 11 months of this year, while allied industry exports gained 11.1 percent to 730.83 million.

Vehicle exports were led by passenger car exports, which rose 5.9 percent to $250.24 million. Bus, midibus and minibus exports jumped 59.5 percent from a year ago to $189.14 million in the 11-month period.
